configurePresets.name: android-vulkan-stage1

configurePresets.name: android-vulkan
configurePresets.description: Android ARM64 cross-compile with strict Halide Vulkan GPU backend (vk_int8/vk_int16/vk_int64; Stage 2 requires Stage 1 first)

configurePresets.name: windows-vulkan
configurePresets.description: Single-stage native Windows x64 build with the Halide Vulkan GPU backend. Generators run natively, so no host/target split is needed (unlike Android). Run from a Developer Command Prompt / after vcvars64.bat so Ninja can find the MSVC headers and libs, with LLVM's clang-cl on PATH and the LunarG Vulkan SDK installed (VULKAN_SDK set). clang-cl is mandatory: dng_sdk needs -ffp-contract=off for the byte-exact Stage4 colour contract, which cl.exe cannot express.

configurePresets.name: linux-vulkan
configurePresets.description: Single-stage native Linux x86-64 build with the Halide Vulkan GPU backend. The host is the target, so no host/target split is needed (unlike Android). Runtime prerequisite: a Vulkan ICD on the host (libvulkan1 plus a driver such as mesa-vulkan-drivers); the Halide Vulkan runtime dlopen's libvulkan.so.1 rather than linking it, so no Vulkan SDK is required at build time. The strict AOT target (host-vulkan-vk_int8-vk_int16-vk_int64-...) is selected automatically by native/cmake/halide_aot.cmake, not pinned here.
